title: Detailed lemon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Main lemon body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='36' ry='26' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <!-- Lighter highlight on top-left -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='42' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#FFE44D'/>
  <!-- Brightest highlight spot -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='38' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#FFF5A0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Bottom shadow band -->
  <path d='M18 56 Q50 82 82 56 Q80 74 50 76 Q20 74 18 56 Z' fill='#E6B800'/>
  <!-- Darker underside crescent -->
  <path d='M24 62 Q50 84 76 62 Q74 76 50 78 Q26 76 24 62 Z' fill='#CC9900' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Left nub -->
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='52' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <ellipse cx='14' cy='52' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#E6B800'/>
  <!-- Right nub -->
  <ellipse cx='84' cy='52' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <ellipse cx='86' cy='52' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#E6B800'/>
  <!-- Pore dots / texture -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='50' r='1.2' fill='#E6B800' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='58' r='1' fill='#E6B800' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='48' r='1.2' fill='#E6B800' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='56' r='1' fill='#E6B800' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='58' r='1' fill='#E6B800' opacity='0.4'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='52' r='1.2' fill='#E6B800' opacity='0.4'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='65' r='0.9' fill='#E6B800' opacity='0.4'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='62' r='0.9' fill='#E6B800' opacity='0.4'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='68' r='0.8' fill='#E6B800' opacity='0.3'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='44' r='0.8' fill='#E6B800' opacity='0.3'/>
  <!-- Stem area at top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='26' rx='6' ry='3' fill='#CC9900'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='25' rx='4' ry='2' fill='#B38600'/>
  <!-- Green leaf -->
  <path d='M52 26 Q64 14 72 20 Q66 28 52 26 Z' fill='#5BC236'/>
  <path d='M52 26 Q62 19 68 21 Q63 26 52 26 Z' fill='#7EDC4F'/>
  <!-- Second smaller leaf -->
  <path d='M47 27 Q38 15 33 20 Q36 27 47 27 Z' fill='#4AA82E'/>
  <path d='M47 27 Q39 19 35 21 Q38 26 47 27 Z' fill='#6BCF43'/>
  <!-- Sun gleam reflection -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='40' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#FFF8C6' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
